title: `<div data="[object Object]">` in 1.3.0
body:
I just moved from 1.2 to 1.3, and I realize that my markup now have a lot of `data="[object Object]"` while inspecting with the Chrome inspector. This has no side effect that I can currently see, but this seems like something that shouldn't be visible in the markup.
